notes.title: Celestia: Chain of Fate is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011416/721ceb603d014d5c708f0f4d7e8877fdd729c5c0.png[/img]

Celestia: Chain of Fate is OUT NOW!

A world of fantasy and romance, Celestia: Chain of Fate blends school, magic, and mythical creatures in new and unexpected ways.

[previewyoutube=jhJu76Yw2vk;full][/previewyoutube]

With three male leads to romance and explore, play as Aria, a rare daemon-angelus hybrid, and experience her growth as she fights to become the ultimate graduate. Venture into new territory through Aria's eyes as she paves a path for herself in foreign lands, and forge unbreakable alliances with the sons of some very powerful figures. Experience the true strength of bonds born through adversity, and the power of true love.

notes.title: Come and watch us play Celestia: Chain of Fate Tomorrow!
notes.notes:
Don't miss our live stream TOMORROW!

A fantasy otome visual novel, in 'Celestia: Chain of Fate' you play as a young noble that enrols at a mysterious academy filed with magic, angels, and demons. Uncover your family history and develop relationships with one of three characters, while also prioritising your education.

In the demo you can play the first two chapters, revealing the backstory behind Aria’s heritage as a hybrid and the start of her journey towards finding herself, her magic, and maybe even her love interest.

notes.title: CELESTIA: CHAIN OF FATE DEMO IS HERE!
notes.notes:
The DEMO has arrived!

Step into a realm of romance and magic in this Otome visual novel!

Journey from your familiar life into an enchanting new adventure.

Discover Daemons, Angelus, and Humans, and even explore the possibility of falling in love with one.

In this demo, you'll experience the first two chapters, offering a couple of hours of engaging gameplay. Make crucial decisions that will shape your story and determine whether you will attend Celestia academy.

Three intriguing boys await your arrival… Dive in and let the adventure begin!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011416/fa65869b0abf5d121f2dc262a7c971ab8f8c90c9.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Celestia: Chain of fate is Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011416/cca107211ea0c4b166dade68952f3fb7a56a9227.png[/img]

We are so excited to announce the arrival of the Otome visual novel, [b]Celestia: Chain of Fate![/b]

The perfect life you once thought you had will change forever…  

[previewyoutube=9tJXh7mbAjo;full][/previewyoutube]

Starting at a new school is never easy, but a school of magic brings a whole other host of challenges. Explore a world filled with magic by accepting your invitation to the [i]Celestia Academy.[/i]

Through your journey, build friendships and develop relationships with one of the three romanceable characters. Discover who you can trust and who you must avoid, BUT make sure to pay attention as tasks and challenges must be completed in order to graduate. 

Immerse into a captivating player-driven visual novel where your choices matter, and unravel the mystery behind your heritage as you forge a path unique to yourself, as the descendant of an Angelus and Daemon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011416/c30943352c1dafa20e08219966bb2a911281e99c.gif[/img]
